notes.title: Help get on Steam!
notes.notes:
<Fastigium: Dead End> is the 2nd edition of <Fastigium>.It provides 3 huge maps which players could move freely. The further you explore, the more fatal dangers you will face to. Take the shotgun and Kanata! Kill them! Fight your way out!

Support for HTC Vive.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=846124633&searchtext=Fastigium

Thank you for your vote!
